[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-g3[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Diff-scoped selection soundness — measure the blind spot now, stop [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]degrading silently, and stop depending on a CI artifact[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]The reliability of `just check`'s diff-scoped test lane becomes a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]measured property rather than an assumed one: a backtest over real [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]historical commits reports selection recall against per-test [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]coverage ground truth today instead of waiting weeks for organic [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]samples, a missing or stale coverage-contexts baseline provokes a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]named and measured compensating action instead of silently [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]narrowing the selection, an agent can see what the scoped lane [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]actually did on the success path, and a workspace can obtain a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]baseline from a local full run instead of depending solely on a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]14-day CI artifact.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]selection_soundness.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Parent: [#87AFFF][/dim]202608/test_suite_tier1.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-g3[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-g3/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Historical backtest of selection recall against coverage [/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]ground truth[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]backtest[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]backtest: add a `tools/selection_backtest` harness (plus a `just [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]selection-backtest` recipe) that replays the last N real commits, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]computes the selection each diff would have produced, and reports recall[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]against per-test coverage-context ground truth — so the epic's unmet [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]exit criterion is answerable now rather than after weeks of organic [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sample growth.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Make the scoped lane's selection and degradation visible on [/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
      [bold #D7AFFF]the success path[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]visible[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]visible: `tools/run_silent` discards captured output on success, so a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]passing `just check` shows only `✓ test (scoped)` and hides how many [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tests ran, whether the run escalated, and whether the contexts baseline [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]was missing; surface a one-line scoped summary that survives the success[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]path.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]A named, measured compensating action for a missing or stale [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]contexts baseline[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]compensate[dim] · [dim][/dim]after backtest[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]compensate: `context-baseline-missing` and `context-baseline-stale` are [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]recorded but are absent from `FULL_SUITE_RULES` and widen nothing, so [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]roughly half of scoped runs narrow silently; choose and implement a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]compensating action on the backtest's measured recall evidence, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]record it as a named rule.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Record a contexts baseline from a local full run[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]baseline[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]baseline: only `tools/fetch_coverage_contexts` installs a baseline into [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the host-local cache, so an instrumented local run's database is [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]invisible to selection; let a local `cov-contexts` run install itself as[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a `<sha>.sqlite` baseline so a workspace is not dependent on the CI [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]artifact alone.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Land the selection-soundness epic[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]land[dim] · [dim][/dim]after backtest, visible, compensate, baseline[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]land: re-read `just selection-health` and the backtest report on the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]combined tree, state the honest recall reading, file collected [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]follow-ups with /sase_new_task, run `just check-full` and `just [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]symvision`, and close the epic.[/#D7D7AF]
